newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 25.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Sept 25.

text.p: -- Loewen Group Inc rejected a takeover offer from Service Corp Inc.
Loewen shares closed at 41 on Tuesday on the Nasdaq. Service closed at 30.
-- Dallas Semiconductor Corp said after the market's close on Tuesday that it expects third quarter earnings per share to be down from a year ago.
-- Best Products Co Inc filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy. It closed at 11/32.

-- Checkpoint Systems Inc said its third quarter revenues would fall below expectations because of the impact of Hurricane Hortense and delayed product rollout in supermarket chains. It closed at 36-3/8.
-- 3Com Corp's share price rose in after-hours trading following news that in the company's first quarter earnings jumped to $0.52 a share from $0.33 a year ago.

-- Cirrus Logic Inc unveiled a chipset for 3-D graphics applications and said its series of new multimedia products was likely to produce some payback in revenue growth this quarter and next. It closed at 17.
-- Apple South Inc said its 1996 profits will not match analysts' estimates of $0.95 a share. It cited a sluggish restaurant environment and management turnover. It closed at 20-7/8.
-- Apria Healthcare Group Inc said it expects third quarter net income of $0.38 to $0.42 a share, below analysts' expectations. It closed at 20-3/4.
